messages:
maya: Hey team — PR 2412 is ready for merge but CI is failing on the Windows snapshot shard. Locally tests pass. Can someone help with a targeted rerun + quick approval so we can hit the merge window? :hourglass: ethan: Which snapshot is flaking? tiny log snippet? maya: Failing test is `components/Header/snap` on shard-5. Minimal log: ``` Error: Snapshot mismatch for Header - collapsed state - expected + received @@ -
Old title
+
New title
``` Looks like an expected update but CI didn't get the updated snapshot file. sasha: Hmm that usually means the snapshot job used an older artifact. Did you push the updated .snap file in this PR? maya: Yep, updated snapshots in the PR (files changed + snapshot update commit). Locally `yarn test:ci --updateSnapshot` is green. I suspect a flaky runner or stale cache. ci-bot: Jenkins job #4821 (pr-2412) failed on windows-shard-5 with exit code 1. Artifacts uploaded: https://ci.internal/4821/artifacts ethan: We can do a targeted rerun of shard-5. @luke-oncall can you bump priority or trigger a rerun (only rerun failing job) so we don't re-run the whole matrix? :pray: luke-oncall: Oncall here — will schedule a targeted rerun in ~2m. If it flakes again, we'll run a clean matrix. Triggering now. ci-bot: Triggered targeted rerun: Jenkins #4821.2 (windows-shard-5) maya: Thanks — pinging @sasha for a quick approval once green. I left one follow-up comment about extracting a tiny helper but it's non-blocking. sasha: Saw the comment — non-blocking LGTM. I'll approve once CI clears. ethan: Quick question: does this snapshot change touch any security-sensitive UI? If not, we can fast-track. maya: No sensitive changes — purely label text update. ci-bot: Targeted rerun finished: Jenkins #4821.2 — SUCCESS. All tests passed. maya: Awesome, thanks @luke-oncall and CI. @sasha please approve when you have a sec. sasha: Approving now. :white_check_mark: maya: Got approvals (2) and green CI. Planning to merge in the next merge window slot (in ~4m). Will monitor post-merge pipeline. ethan: Nice. If we see repeated flakes on shard-5 over the week, we should schedule a flaky quarantine and investigate runner cache. luke-oncall: Noted — I'll add a short card to triage run: flaky-runner/shard-5 and track frequency. maya: Thanks everyone. Merging now. :rocket: ci-bot: Merge performed: PR 2412 merged by maya. Post-merge pipeline started: https://ci.internal/4830 maya: Post-merge pipeline green as well. Closing out. :tada:
